subject: FILM
title: Internship: World Cinemas
description: Internship with an approved host institution or organization.

prerequisites.text: Permission of the World Cinemas Program Chair.

restrictions.text: Open to U2 and U3 B.A. students in World Cinemas after completing 30 credits of a 90 credit program or 45 credits of a 96-120 credit program, a minimum CGPA of 3.2.

notes: This course will normally not fulfill program requirements for seminar or 400-level courses. Students register in the Fall semester for Summer internships.
